queries.name: Residential infill candidates
queries.question: High or Medium Density Residential parcels of at least 800 m² (that zone over at least 90% of the parcel, no other zone over 10%), under 25% covered by PCC's building footprints, 90th-percentile slope under 10°, outside every District Plan 2025 flood and coastal hazard overlay (tsunami is not part of the test) and the area where PCC has not mapped flooding. No sewer condition: Porirua's three waters are not used (D-16). PCC's footprints are mostly undated and miss newer buildings, so check `unmapped_structure_m2`.
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, area_m2, building_m2, unmapped_structure_m2, slope_p90_deg, zones FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND lidar_coverage_pct >= 99 AND (json_extract(zones,'$."High Density Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE >= 90 OR json_extract(zones,'$."Medium Density Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE >= 90) AND zones_total_pct - greatest(coalesce(json_extract(zones,'$."High Density Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE, 0), coalesce(json_extract(zones,'$."Medium Density Residential Zone"')::DOUBLE, 0)) < 10 AND area_m2 >= 800 AND building_m2 < 0.25*area_m2 AND slope_p90_deg < 10 AND pdp_flood_overland_flow IS NULL AND pdp_flood_stream_corridor IS NULL AND pdp_flood_inundation IS NULL AND pdp_coastal_erosion_current IS NULL AND pdp_coastal_erosion_1m_slr IS NULL AND pdp_coastal_inundation_current IS NULL AND pdp_coastal_inundation_1m_slr IS NULL AND pcc_flood_unmapped IS NULL -- where flooding is not mapped, "outside every flood overlay" means nothing ORDER BY area_m2 DESC

queries.name: Coastal hazard with 1 m sea-level rise
queries.question: Parcels with buildings that the District Plan 2025 maps in coastal erosion or the 1-in-100-year storm surge with 1 m sea-level rise (at least 1% of the parcel), but under 1% in the current-day extents and in the Plimmerton Farm Zone, where the 2025 plan does not apply; at least 10 m² of PCC footprints.
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, area_m2, building_m2, pdp_coastal_erosion_1m_slr, pdp_coastal_inundation_1m_slr FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND building_m2 >= 10 -- not a neighbour's footprint edge (fourteenth review) AND (coalesce(json_extract(pdp_coastal_erosion_1m_slr, '$."Coastal erosion with 1 m sea-level rise"')::DOUBLE, 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(json_extract(pdp_coastal_inundation_1m_slr, '$."1-in-100-year storm surge with 1 m sea-level rise"')::DOUBLE, 0) >= 1) -- the same 1% for what excludes a parcel: the current-day extents, and the Plimmerton Farm Zone, where the -- 2025 plan does not apply (thirteenth and fourteenth reviews) AND coalesce(json_extract(pdp_coastal_erosion_current, '$."Current coastal erosion"')::DOUBLE, 0) < 1 AND coalesce(json_extract(pdp_coastal_inundation_current, '$."Current coastal inundation"')::DOUBLE, 0) < 1 AND coalesce(json_extract(plan_1999_plimmerton_farm, '$."Plimmerton Farm Zone (1999 plan; the 2025 plan does not apply)"')::DOUBLE, 0) < 1 ORDER BY area_m2 DESC

queries.name: Heritage, notable tree or significant natural area on the parcel
queries.question: Parcels with a District Plan 2025 heritage item or notable tree point inside or on their boundary, or overlapping a notable tree group, heritage setting, heritage item extent, historic heritage site or significant natural area by at least 1% of the parcel.
queries.sql: SELECT unit_id, appellation, area_m2, pdp_heritage_items, pdp_notable_trees, pdp_notable_tree_groups, pdp_heritage_settings, pdp_heritage_item_extents, pdp_heritage_sites, pdp_significant_natural_areas FROM units WHERE coverage_pct >= 99 AND area_m2 >= 20 AND (pdp_heritage_items <> '[]' OR pdp_notable_trees <> '[]' OR coalesce(list_max(json_extract(pdp_notable_tree_groups, '$.*')::DOUBLE[]), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(list_max(json_extract(pdp_heritage_settings, '$.*')::DOUBLE[]), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(list_max(json_extract(pdp_heritage_item_extents, '$.*')::DOUBLE[]), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(list_max(json_extract(pdp_heritage_sites, '$.*')::DOUBLE[]), 0) >= 1 OR coalesce(list_max(json_extract(pdp_significant_natural_areas, '$.*')::DOUBLE[]), 0) >= 1)
